scope: Third-round structural allocation and deferred diagnostic work; no optimizer/search-policy change
changes: Freeze privately owned pattern and capacity tables after discovery, publish immutable capacity-order lists once, and share these tables with prepared replays; continue copying the mutable capacity-score memo.
Aggregate the first direct-raw input key in local variables, preserve sequential saturating addition for repeated keys, and allocate a mutable per-recipe map only for a second distinct raw key.
Compute diagnostic raw unit costs only when a missing-route tie needs them and memoize only within that linear pass; preserve shared-input dominance and recursive fallback order.
safety_boundaries: Prepared graphs remain bound to one graph identity, target, owner thread and cut orientation; inventory projections compile separate snapshots.
Only structural tables are shared. Recipe lists are immutable, and mutable stock, demand, byproduct and score memo state remain independent.
Post-compilation whole-table traversal performs counting, set union or boolean checks. Route priority uses explicit item order and per-output lists.
Deferred diagnostic cost evaluation reads only immutable recipe metadata and item order, not pass-local demand or stock state.

protocol.coordination: The coordinating instance, its internal agents and third instance paused CPU-intensive tasks for the formal serial ABBA window.
protocol.limitations: Offline normalized recipe graphs, not in-game TPS or a global speed guarantee. All warm samples including the candidate ATM 612 ms outlier are retained. TB counts existing target stock toward demand; AW excludes it.

profiling_notes.purpose: Exploratory hotspot selection; nonexclusive profiling elapsed times are not used as a speed claim.
profiling_notes.full_stack_export: JFR recordings were exported with jfr print --json --stack-depth 128. Default export depth 5 hides outer optimizer oracle frames even when the recorded stack is not truncated.
profiling_notes.interpretation: Most structural compilation work is reached through optimizer oracle probes; outside-optimizer phase labels from earlier shallow JFR exports are not reliable. Nearest-method samples and ABBA measurements are unaffected.
